# Cross-Repository Resolution Fixtures

These offline fixture manifests describe the producer families and exact SCIP
identities used by the cross-repository composition tests. They do not run an
indexer or contact a package registry.

- `python.json` models a consumer/provider pair from `scip-python`.
- `typescript.json` models a consumer/provider pair from `scip-typescript`.

The fixture manifests and their hand-authored source facts are licensed under
Apache-2.0, matching PragmaGraph.
